transfer.title: Send money
transfer.description: Enter the transfer details, then review everything before confirming.

details.title: Transfer details
details.description: Send a simulated transfer from your available wallet balance.

recipient.label: Recipient name
recipient.helper: Enter the recipient name as it should appear on the transfer.

iban.label: Saudi IBAN
iban.helper: Spaces are accepted. The IBAN will be normalized before confirmation.

validation.recipientTooShort: Recipient name must contain at least 2 characters.
validation.recipientTooLong: Recipient name must be {{count}} characters or fewer.
validation.ibanInvalid: Enter a Saudi IBAN beginning with SA followed by 22 digits.
validation.amountInvalid: Enter a valid amount with no more than two decimal places.
validation.amountExceedsBalance: The transfer amount exceeds your available balance.
validation.noteTooLong: The note must be {{count}} characters or fewer.

review.title: Review transfer
review.description: Confirm the recipient and amount before committing this simulated transfer.

receipt.title: Transfer complete
receipt.description: The simulated transfer has been added to this wallet session.

errors.walletUnavailable: Your wallet data is unavailable. Try loading it again.
errors.insufficient_balance: Your available balance is no longer enough for this transfer. Edit the amount and try again.
errors.invalid_amount: The transfer amount is no longer valid. Edit it and try again.
errors.invalid_iban: The recipient IBAN is no longer valid. Edit it and try again.
errors.request_failed: The simulated transfer could not be completed. Try again.

success.title: Transfer complete
success.description: Your wallet balance and recent activity are up to date.

topUp.title: Top up wallet
topUp.description: Choose an amount and review the simulated top up before confirming.

details.title: Top-up amount
details.description: Choose a preset or enter a custom amount.

source.disclaimer: Demo source only. No bank or payment provider is connected.

validation.amountRequired: Choose or enter a top-up amount.
validation.amountInvalid: Enter a valid amount with no more than two decimal places.

review.title: Review top up
review.description: Confirm the amount before adding it to this mock wallet session.

receipt.title: Top up complete
receipt.description: The simulated top up has been added to this wallet session.

errors.walletUnavailable: Your wallet data is unavailable. Try loading it again.
errors.invalid_amount: The top-up amount is no longer valid. Edit it and try again.
